context: Besides this convergence result, we note that by Proposition 7 the OTC distance and d(∞) WL,δ have the same zero-sets for any δ > 0. This implies that although the OTC distance is an upper bound for d(∞) WL,δ , our new construction has the same discriminative power as the OTC distance.
